data.name: Fritze
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old High German 'frid' meaning 'peace' and 'thi' meaning 'people' or 'god'. In the Middle Ages, Fritze was a unisex name. However, it is now predominantly used as a feminine name. In Germanic mythology, Fritze was the name of a goddess of peace and fertility.
data.numerology_meaning: Nurturer and healer, Fritze is deeply caring and compassionate. She has a natural ability to heal and nurture those around her.
